name: CW Metals Inc. Sheet Metal Fabrication
old_description: Our professional and experienced team takes care of most complex projects. We provide help with design, shop drawings, suggestions how to make your project better and more cost-effective.
about:
CW Metals Inc. operates from Long Island City, New York, where it specializes in ornamental metal stamping and sheet metal fabrication for the construction industry. The company’s professional team handles complex projects, offering design assistance, shop drawings, and suggestions to improve cost-effectiveness.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, custom and standard metal stamping, 2D laser cutting, assembly, and installation of components such as cornices, bay windows, wall panels, and roofing panels. A high‑tech 3D printing machine produces stamping molds directly from drawings or photos when no physical sample exists. Finished parts are shipped throughout the United States and Canada.

CW Metals serves construction, engineering, aerospace, and manufacturing sectors, with a notable focus on historic preservation and architectural metalwork. Project examples include the TEP Charter School in Manhattan, a hospitality and high‑end residential complex in New York City, the Tres Puentes housing complex in the Bronx, a copper skylight, and a sheet metal cornice — all recognized with six Lucy G. Moses Preservation Awards and two Preservation League of New York State awards.

The company emphasizes its innovative technology, claiming to be the fastest producer of ornamental sheet‑metal stampings in the United States, along with a commitment to quality, low cost, and the shortest lead times in the construction industry.
